title: Cartwise+ Membership Household Sharing Terms
content:
A Cartwise+ Membership shares its benefits with a household only where the plan has more than one seat. The seat count includes the holder.

| Plan | Seats (holder included) | Minimum age of an added household member | Days before a removed member can be added back | Member removals allowed per paid period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 1 | 18 years | 0 | 0 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 1 | 18 years | 0 | 0 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 1 | 18 years | 0 | 0 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 1 | 18 years | 0 | 0 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 5 | 18 years | 30 | 3 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 2 | 18 years | 30 | 1 |

## Reading the table

- A plan with 1 seat covers the holder alone; Cartwise+ Family Annual covers the holder and up to four others, and Cartwise+ Premier Annual the holder and one other.
- The re-add cooldown is counted in calendar days after the removal date.
